newsitem.title: USA: Rowe Furniture says authorizes buy back.
newsitem.headline: Rowe Furniture says authorizes buy back.

text.p: Rowe Furniture Corp said on Tuesday that its directors had approved the repurchase of an additional 250,000 shares of the company's common stock, bringing the total remaining authorized shares the company can purchase in open market transactions to 450,000 shares.

The approval follows the November 6 authorization by Rowe Furniture directors to purchase 500,000 of its common shares in the open market. In a statement, Rowe said it had purchased roughly 300,000 of those shares to date.
Rowe Furniture Corp manufactures medium-priced furniture that is sold throughout the U.S. and abroad.
